primary_source_binding.paper: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring
source_facts: Legacy local states have only cardinality patterns 000, 001, 111.
S(Q) is the union of all local representative vertices.
Z(T,T') is defined separately for 000, 001, 111; legacy 111 has Z(T,T')=empty.
Q-admissible f' is defined on S(Q) union Z(Q) and must satisfy endpoint color restrictions, forced Z colors, and global properness.
P_{Q,f'} is built only after these projections are fixed and is asserted to be a normal subcase.
The polynomial counting uses |V(Q_{T,T'})|<=3, bounded |S(Q)|, polynomially many Q, and unique admissible completion on Z(Q) once S(Q) is precolored.

objective: Define exactly one mathematical candidate state schema capable in principle of representing the verified rigid P7 split corridor while preserving every interface and polynomial-accounting obligation identified by the minimal-state audit. No implementation or enumeration is authorized by this preregistration.

required_fields: exact local vertex roles admitted by the candidate state
exact subset promoted into the enlarged seed
maximum number b(|S|) of stored/promoted vertices per ordered type-pair
local certificate explaining how promoted vertices attach to the legacy seed
proof_obligations: G[S union support_projection] is connected for one local state
the union of support projections over all relevant ordered type-pairs preserves connectedness globally
support membership is checkable in polynomial time
1_SUPPORT_PROJECTION.forbidden_shortcut: Do not assume both rigid-corridor Y0 witnesses belong to support merely because they are stored.

required_fields: exact set-valued rule Z_state(T,T') for every new mode
all graph/state predicates used by that rule
proof that Z_state is polynomial-time computable
proof_obligations: legacy 000/001/111 reproduce their original Z(T,T') exactly
new rigid-corridor Z semantics must be derived, not inherited from legacy 111
the global Z(Q) is the union of local Z_state sets and remains compatible with the normal-subcase constructor
2_Z_SELECTOR.explicit_unknown_before_schema: Whether the rigid-corridor mode has empty, nonempty, or partitioned Z_state.

required_fields: allowed/forbidden colors for each attachment-carrier role
forced color rule, if any, for Z_state
global proper-coloring condition for f union f'

z_completion_multiplicity_contract.requirement: The candidate must choose and prove one of the following before implementation.

alternatives.UNIQUE_Z_COMPLETION: For every fixed support coloring, there is at most one admissible completion on Z(Q), computable in polynomial time.
alternatives.BOUNDED_Z_COMPLETION: For every fixed support coloring, the number of admissible Z(Q)-completions is at most n^{h(|S|)} for an explicit fixed function h, and all completions are enumerable in n^{h(|S|)} time.

z_completion_multiplicity_contract.rationale: A polynomially computable Z-selector alone does not preserve the polynomial proof if Z admits exponentially many independent color completions.

required_fields: global composition rule over all ordered type-pairs
4_CONNECTIVITY_CONTRACT.theorem_obligation: For every admitted global state Q_new, the enlarged seed induced by S union S_new(Q_new) is connected.

symbolic_parameters.t: number of relevant ordered type-pairs, with legacy bound t <= 2^{2s}
symbolic_parameters.b_s: maximum number of stored/promoted vertex identities per type-pair
symbolic_parameters.r_s: number of finite mode labels / non-vertex local metadata choices
symbolic_parameters.h_s: exponent bounding Z-completion multiplicity, h_s=0 in UNIQUE mode

required_derivations_before_implementati: |Q_new| <= n^{b(s)*t} * r(s), or a strictly smaller explicit bound
total generated candidate count <= n^{q(s)} for an explicit fixed q
5_POLYNOMIAL_BUDGET.total_cost_firewall: For fixed bounded seed size s, construction + state discovery + Z completion enumeration + subcase construction + reconstruction must all be polynomial in n with one explicitly derived exponent bound.

conservative_embedding.name: LEGACY_COMMON_COMMUTING_EMBEDDING
conservative_embedding.requirement: The candidate language must be a conservative extension of all legacy local states.
conservative_embedding.failure_rule: If any legacy equality fails, reject the candidate schema before any SPLIT experiment.

SOUNDNESS.statement: Every extension of every generated candidate subcase reconstructs an extension of the original seeded precoloring P.

COMPLETENESS.statement: For every extension c of the original P, the candidate state-generation rule produces at least one state and admissible completion whose subcase is extended by c.
COMPLETENESS.rationale: The legacy proof uses a common z supplied by Lemma 4 in order to construct a valid Q object; a new state schema must replace this step exactly.

required_before_any_code: All five sections contain no semantic UNKNOWN for the proposed rigid-corridor mode.
A concrete finite local mode/tag and its membership predicate are mathematically defined.
Z-completion multiplicity contract is explicit and polynomially bounded.
connectivity theorem obligation is discharged at specification level.
SOUNDNESS and COMPLETENESS statements are frozen separately.

forbidden: claim soundness or completeness from schema shape alone
claim complexity progress from bounded local arity alone
infer hardness from failure of a candidate schema
infer P=NP from any scoped success
immediate_next_action: Produce one complete mathematical candidate schema satisfying sections 1-5 and the conservative embedding, or return CANDIDATE_SCHEMA_SPEC_OPEN with the exact unresolved field. Do not implement.
stop_rule: STOP after schema specification and preregistered soundness/completeness obligations. No automatic experiment.
